text: Harvard anthropologist Dennis Alan is sent to Haiti, in the middle of a revolution, to find [the voodoo drug that makes zombies|images|food, drink and drugs] for a pharmaceutical company that wants a super anesthetic. He finds Christophe, buried seven years earlier yet alive, and draws the eye of Captain Peytraud, [commander of the Tonton Macoute|threat|the powerful and their systems] and a bokor who [steals the souls of his enemies|wants|claiming souls and victims]. Tortured and framed for murder, Alan returns anyway, and is [buried alive with a tarantula|images|graves, coffins and funerals].
